item.title: SCOTTISH CUP SEMI-FINAL DRAW: ALL YOU NEED TO KNOW
item.description: CELTIC face a delay to learn their Scottish Cup semi-final opponents – if, of course, they triumph at Ibrox tomorrow afternoon.
